title: Migrate to data tiers routing configures correct default for mounted indices

timeline.message: Migrate to data tiers routing configures correct default for mounted indices
timeline.author: Andrei Dan

timeline.body:
This fixes the default tier preference configuration the 
migrate to tier routing API sets for fully and partially mounted
indices when the index was not migrated using the requested
attribute name and it doesn't have any `_tier_preference`
setting configured.

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/97898
